PRE-LAUNCH PREVIEW · CONTENT & INTEGRATIONS IN REVIEW
OUR PROCESS

Momentum needs
a method.

A clear route from the first question to the next measurable improvement.

01

Discover

Understand the business, the buyer and the systems.

Stakeholder conversations, analytics review, technical audit and a documented baseline.

02

Strategy

Choose the work that matters most.

Prioritized roadmap, scope, success measures, responsibilities and dependencies.

03

Build

Deliver in visible increments.

Agreed sprint cadence, working demos, acceptance criteria and issue tracking.

04

Launch

Release with a clear go/no-go decision.

Functional, accessibility, security and performance checks; deployment and rollback plan.

05

Optimize

Turn evidence into the next decision.

Reporting on an agreed cadence, experiment backlog and prioritization review.

No surprises by design.

Delivery governance

Agree sprint length, meeting rhythm and approval owners at kickoff.

Support expectations

Response targets, service hours and SLAs are scoped in the engagement agreement.

Quality gates

Document acceptance criteria and QA evidence before releasing work.
